text_block_list.text: Of course I'd lose. It was obvious.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I got too cocky without having
the talent
to back it up.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this loss couldn't be helped. Yeah,
that's it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The Derby was fun, wasn't it?! I was able
to show
my full power!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
But my fans are expecting more from me!
I have
to go beyond my current limit!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Woooo! I'm getting super fired up! I'll
surpass my
limits a million times over if I
have to!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...While I'm over here making excuses
about how
maybe the distance was too
long, or I just wasn't
ready...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...No wonder the spotlight is always on
her.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And it will continue to stay on her...
forever.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
